models_evaluated: CADe computer-aided detection system for colonoscopy

links.outcome: Advanced adenoma detection rate, ADR, and adenomas per colonoscopy with CADe versus standard colonoscopy in randomized trial
links.effect: AADR comparable (21.3% vs 20.5%, p=0.794); ADR higher with CADe (67.6% vs 59.8%, p=0.012); APC 1.82 vs 1.34 (p<0.001); withdrawal time longer (17.10 vs 16.13 min, p=0.016).
links.quote: AADR was comparable between the groups (21.3% vs. 20.5%, p = 0.794).

screen.reason: Multicenter randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical impact of computer-aided detection (CADe) during colonoscopy in a live screening program, testing the tool's effectiveness rather than a deployment practice or safeguard.
